تشترعوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِعُوا (taštariʕū) /taʃ.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# تُشْتَرَعُوا (tuštaraʕū) /tuʃ.ta.ra.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
